records.claim: There is published information about more than 15,000 pregnancies exposed to citalopram or escitalopram. Most studies have not found that these medications increase the chance of birth defects. While some studies have suggested a higher chance of heart defects or other birth defects with use of citalopram or escitalopram, most of these studies have flaws that make it hard to know if the birth defects were due to the medication or to other factors.
